1.web: But know this, that in the last days, grievous times will come.
1.asv: But know this, that in the last days grievous times shall come.

2.web: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
2.asv: For men shall be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, haughty, railers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

3.web: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,
3.asv: without natural affection, implacable, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, no lovers of good,

4.web: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;
4.asv: traitors, headstrong, puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;

5.web: holding a form of godliness, but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.
5.asv: holding a form of godliness, but having denied the power thereof: from these also turn away.

6.web: For some of these are people who creep into houses, and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
6.asv: For of these are they that creep into houses, and take captive silly women laden with sins, led away by divers lusts,

7.web: always learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
7.asv: ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

8.web: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so do these also oppose the truth; men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith, are rejected.
8.asv: And even as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also withstand the truth; men corrupted in mind, reprobate concerning the faith.

9.web: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.
9.asv: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be evident unto all men, as theirs also came to be.

10.web: But you did follow my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
10.asv: But thou didst follow my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, patience,

11.web: persecutions, and sufferings: those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
11.asv: persecutions, sufferings; what things befell me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: and out of them all the Lord delivered me.

12.web: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
12.asv: Yea, and all that would live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

13.web: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
13.asv: But evil men and impostors shall wax worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

14.web: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
14.asv: But abide thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;

15.web: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith, which is in Christ Jesus.
15.asv: and that from a babe thou hast known the sacred writings which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

16.web: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,
16.asv: Every scripture inspired of God is also profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for instruction which is in righteousness:

17.web: that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
17.asv: that the man of God may be complete, furnished completely unto every good work.
